leadText: Masquerade (Japanese: マスカレード) is one of the Ghost Masters located in the Sealed Fort, located on GR Island in Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! Masquerade can be found in the seventh of the nine statues in the main room. Players who defeat Masquerade will obtain a Present Pack, which can consist of any card that can be found in a booster pack in the game.
plainText:
Masquerade (Japanese: マスカレード) is one of the Ghost Masters located in the Sealed Fort, located on GR Island in Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! Masquerade can be found in the seventh of the nine statues in the main room. Players who defeat Masquerade will obtain a Present Pack, which can consist of any card that can be found in a booster pack in the game.

==Power of Darkness Deck==
Power of Darkness Deck (Japanese: あんこくのパワーデッキ) is the deck played by Masquerade. The deck features the promotional , which was created to promote the game, as well as several types of Dark Pokémon, one of which is also exclusive to this version of the game.
